'''Chongwang''' is an NPC in [[Jinzhou]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Congwang:''' Huh? What happened to "We always deliver"? Why not accept my order?!
:{{DIcon}} What order?
:'''Congwang:''' I heard stories of a city in the clouds, with buildings floating and connected by skywalks... I want them to express deliver me there!
:'''Congwang:''' Their ads claimed, "Where you desire, our packages never tire!" But I came all this way only for them to tell me they can't transport living people...
:'''Congwang:''' I just want to see it with my own eyes. What's so wrong with that?
{{Dialogue End}}
